description: Config actually read by this repo's code. The only consumer is tools/cc/src/cc/commands/eval.py (`cc eval --agent <name>`), which reads `eval.pass_rate_threshold`. A prior `gates`/`defaultGates` block (npm test/lint/build commands) was removed: nothing in this repo reads it, no hook or command executes gates before task completion, and this repo has no package.json scripts named test/lint/build to run anyway (root package.json defines only `generate-summary`). If a real pre-completion gate runner is added later, wire it here and update this description.

eval.description: cc eval pass-rate gate. Exit non-zero if pass_rate < threshold or any P0 case regresses. Used by: cc eval --agent <name>. Trigger: VERSION.json agents version bump.
